verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for an AI assistant and coding CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out in Kimi, Kimi Code CLI/Desktop or the API platform. The Admin API's usage and audit-log queries are admin reporting, not a user-facing opt-out, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
